shorewalk.note: Eye level on the strand looking inland: waterline, beach, riprap, grass and the wooded bluff behind. Judges ground materials and vegetation.

lakeview.note: Spawn view: standing on the pit apron looking down -Z over Lake Washington and the race course. The establishing shot.

racecourse.note: Over deep water looking down the hydroplane race course.

logboom.note: Alongside the log boom, looking back along the raft of spectator boats.

blueangels.note: Looking up over the lake as the Blue Angels come over.

pits.note: Inside the Stan Sayres pits looking across the festival ground toward the water.

needle.note: Hero shot of the Space Needle and the alien structure grafted onto it.

waterline.note: Just above the lake surface in genuinely deep water, looking out. Judges water shading, wave silhouette, foam, sun glitter.

skyline.note: Out on the lake looking back at the shore, the bluff and the city plateau. Judges terrain, vegetation, city massing.

sunward.note: Into the sun over open water. Judges sky scattering, bloom, sun glitter, lens response.

mobile.note: Phone landscape at low quality, spawn view. Must still read as a beautiful game.

sunglitter.note: Over deep water with the sun's azimuth dead ahead. Judges the glitter path, Fresnel ramp and the water/sky horizon.

covenant.note: Down the beach at the Remnant landing zone from the pit apron. Judges enemy silhouettes, colour separation and readability against the shore.
